clips.title: The story
paras: Deep in the southern Barrens, the Scourge now holds Razorfen Downs, the quilboar's ancestral burial ground and capital. Led by the lich Amnennar the Coldbringer, its agents have raised the quilboar dead and threaten to spread their power across central Kalimdor.

Razorfen Downs shares the towering, petrified vines of nearby Razorfen Kraul. It lies where the boar demigod Agamaggan fell in the War of the Ancients. For generations, this thorn labyrinth was the quilboar's sacred burial ground and seat of power, guarded by mystics of the Death's Head tribe. The quilboar hold its dense briars holy, for they were soaked in their divine progenitor's blood.

The Scourge has broken the sanctity of Razorfen Downs. Amnennar the Coldbringer, a powerful lich who serves the Lich King, subdued the Death's Head quilboar and made their ancestral resting ground an undead stronghold. Reanimated quilboar skeletons and corpses, along with shrieking banshees, prowl the Spiral of Thorns. The Horde in the nearby Barrens and emissaries from Stormwind's Cathedral of Light both see this Scourge power as a grave threat to Kalimdor.
